channel.title: Potomac Local News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Potomac Local News (potomaclocal.com)

item.title: Winter Storm Watch Issued
item.description: A Winter Storm Watch has been issued for Prince William County, Manassas, and Manassas Park as forecasters track a coastal storm that could bring accumulating snow late Sunday into Monday.

item.title: Potomac Crisis Center Posts Early Results
item.description: Prince William County officials shared the first detailed performance update on the Potomac District Crisis Receiving Center, highlighting fewer out-of-area transfers and less time officers spend waiting at hospitals.

item.title: Don’t Rush the Sale of the Old Moncure School Property
item.description: I urge you to reconsider the proposed sale of the 10 acres of prime real estate at the former Moncure Elementary School site. Quite simply, selling this property under the current arrangement is not in the best interest of Stafford County.

item.title: Four Found Dead In Woodbridge Home
item.description: Four people, including a small child, were found dead inside a Woodbridge home Saturday morning in what police are investigating as a murder-suicide.

item.title: Weather Prompts School Schedule Changes
item.description: Public school divisions made announcements on Sunday evening, focusing on safety amid predictions of winter weather that could impact travel in Prince William County, Stafford County, and surrounding areas.

item.title: City Unveils Plans For Yearlong 300th Party
item.description: Fredericksburg will celebrate its 300th birthday in 2028 with a free, year-long series of events, including a river festival, historic ship replicas, sports branding, and commemorative merchandise.

item.title: Manassas Park Reveals Full 2026 Events Calendar
item.description: Manassas Park officials unveiled the city's full 2026 events calendar during the governing body meeting on February 17, featuring dozens of family-friendly activities, a new city run-and-walk event, the debut of a ticketed haunted house, shifted holiday timings, and fireworks on July 2.

item.title: Toddler Among Four Killed in Woodbridge Domestic Incident
item.description: Prince William County police have identified the individuals involved in a domestic-related murder-suicide that left four people dead from knife wounds inside a home in Woodbridge on February 21.

item.title: Prince William School Board Backs Student Protest Rights
item.description: The Prince William County School Board affirmed students' First Amendment rights to peaceful protest during its February 18, 2026, meeting in Prince William County.

item.title: Discover Your Dream Condo in the Heart of Manassas: Cozy, Convenient, and Ready for You!
item.description: Imagine waking up to the gentle glow of morning light streaming through your own private sunroom, sipping coffee while planning your day in one of Northern Virginia's most vibrant spots.
